description: This file contains extension methods for working with Tasks and ValueTasks in C#, providing utilities such as suppressing exceptions, logging, timeouts, cancellation, and result handling, specifically tailored for the Orleans framework.

classes.name: OrleansTaskExtentions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for Task and ValueTask to facilitate common asynchronous programming patterns within Orleans.

methods.name: SuppressThrowing
methods.description: Suppresses exceptions from a ValueTask or Task by configuring await options to continue on captured context and suppress throwing.

methods.name: Ignore
methods.description: Ignores the result of a ValueTask, ensuring any exceptions are observed.

methods.name: LogException
methods.description: Logs exceptions from a Task using an ILogger, with an associated error code and message.

methods.name: SafeExecute
methods.description: Executes an async function, ensuring exceptions are captured as a faulted Task.

methods.name: ExecuteAndIgnoreException
methods.description: Executes an async function and swallows any exceptions, effectively ignoring errors.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of a Task, including its Id and Status.

methods.name: WaitWithThrow
methods.description: Waits for a Task to complete within a specified timeout, throwing TimeoutException if it times out.

methods.name: WaitForResultWithThrow
methods.description: Waits for a Task<T> to complete within a timeout and returns its result, throwing TimeoutException if it times out.

methods.name: WithTimeout
methods.description: Applies a timeout to a Task or Task<T>, throwing TimeoutException if the task does not complete in time.

methods.name: WithCancellation
methods.description: Wraps a Task to make it cancellable with a CancellationToken, or throws if already canceled.

methods.name: MakeCancellable
methods.description: Helper method to create a cancellable version of a Task using a CancellationToken.

methods.name: WrapInTask
methods.description: Wraps an Action in a Task, capturing exceptions.

methods.name: GetResult
methods.description: Retrieves the result of a Task<T> synchronously, propagating exceptions.

methods.name: WhenCancelled
methods.description: Returns a Task that completes when a CancellationToken is canceled.
